result.title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
result.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/
result.summary: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DRIFT：将驾驶中间表示投影到语言嵌入空间，由小于 150M 的轻量 LM 完成场景描述与动作评论，并把 LM 推理特征蒸馏为 surrogate reasoning 特征训练规划模块，使推理可在运行时开启或旁路。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“蒸馏出的 surrogate 推理特征可替代 LM 推理”与运行时按需开关推理，与 LVR 中 latent 状态承载推理、THINK/STOP 收益—成本权衡与视觉旁路问题可能相关，可供核查；但推理仍发生在语言空间，评估限于驾驶闭环指标。
